name: @pryzm/site-parcel-data
description: C58 — L2 pure zoning-rules engine + buildable-envelope solver (the C57/C58 shared parcel-data home). Deterministic (byte-identical output), no THREE/DOM/I-O/RNG. Resolves parcel + zoning record + curated JurisdictionZoningContract rule pack → BuildableEnvelope (per-edge setback inset in scene-XZ metres + max height/FAR + mandatory confidence label + per-constraint DerivationTrace). Ships the honest `estimated-default` rule pack; real ZoningProvider adapters (DK Plandata / ES MUC) are the L-399 track.
